definition: The height or extent cannot be computed from the available information.
A reference surface or level is required before computation.
A vertical CRS or datum is required before computation.
A legal or jurisdictional rule is required before computation.
One or more required upper or lower boundary definitions are missing.
Some but not all required vertical boundaries can be computed.
The available information is sufficient to compute a value.
The value has been computed and should include derivation provenance.
Computation is not applicable to the declared representation.
